evidence_slices.fact: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons can be viewed/downloaded and the data is updated monthly.
Dataset applies to England and Wales; contains locations of freehold registered property; polygons show position and indicative extent of a registered property.
Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID that relates to a registered title.
Data is accessed via the Use land and property data service and published as GML files for GIS use.
